verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a model lifecycle from release to retirement, a List/Retrieve Models endpoint, and per-model cards. None of it mentions exact versioned model IDs, aliases that track the latest release, or a documented alias-to-version policy. The lifecycle and catalog material is adjacent to this story but does not deliver it.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pin an exact versioned model ID while aliases track the latest release, with the alias-to-version policy documented
